# Murray Legal

Murray Legal is a boutique law firm serving clients in Yonkers, Westchester County, New York, New York City, and Pennsylvania.

Services:
- Real Estate Law
- Land Use & Zoning
- Commercial Real Estate Transactions
- Residential Real Estate Transactions
- Corporate Law
- Corporate Governance
- Civil Litigation
- Business Disputes
- Personal Injury
- Entertainment Law
- Sports Transactions
